$comment: Coverage of the preset bank. 'categories': the ingredients each category's presets should use between them (only ones that make musical sense there); tools/lib/coverage.ts defines each ingredient. 'iconic': the must-have sounds (synthwave, dark synthwave, cyberpunk, Vangelis/Blade Runner, Stranger Things). Each names its preset, its identity in words, and the ingredients that identity requires: those are protected; LORN treatment goes around them. 'targets': other must-have sounds (the short basses).

iconic.name: Driving octave bass
iconic.identity: Saw or pulse bass jumping octaves in driving 8ths; a short, snappy filter envelope makes every note bop.

iconic.name: PWM pad with chorus
iconic.identity: Slowly modulated pulse width under a classic stereo chorus; a soft swell in, warm and wide.

iconic.name: Poly brass stab
iconic.identity: Stacked detuned saws, a quick filter swell on every chord, punchy and short.

iconic.name: Tempo-synced arpeggio
iconic.identity: Rhythmic notes with filter movement locked to the tempo and a tempo delay.

iconic.name: Portamento saw lead
iconic.identity: A mono saw lead that glides between notes, with a slow vibrato.

iconic.name: Hard-sync lead
iconic.identity: Oscillator 2 hard-synced and swept, the tearing, vocal sync tone.

iconic.name: FM electric piano
iconic.identity: Two-operator FM tine: a glassy bell-like attack over a soft body; harder playing brings more tine.

iconic.name: String machine
iconic.identity: Thin bright saw strings thickened by an ensemble chorus, with a soft attack.

iconic.name: Aggressive distorted saw bass
iconic.identity: Hard-driven saw bass, distorted and snarling, with a punchy filter.

iconic.name: Pluck with a dotted-eighth delay
iconic.identity: A short pluck whose dotted-eighth echo makes the rhythm.

iconic.name: Giant brass braam
iconic.identity: A huge, low, distorted brass blast that hangs in a vast space.

iconic.name: Gritty industrial bass
iconic.identity: A metallic, grinding bass: FM and fold make it clank.

iconic.name: Metallic FM hit
iconic.identity: A clanging metallic FM impact with a pitch drop.

iconic.name: Glitchy digital ticks
iconic.identity: Crushed digital ticks chopped in time, like a machine reading data.

iconic.name: Pulsing sidechained drone
iconic.identity: A dark drone breathing hard on the beat.

iconic.name: Ethereal choir pad
iconic.identity: Floating, ghostly vowel choir in a vast space.

iconic.name: Expressive brass lead
iconic.identity: A brass lead that brightens as it's held, with a singing vibrato and glide.

iconic.name: Crystal bells
iconic.identity: Clear, glistening FM bells ringing long in a big space.

iconic.name: Swelling brass pad
iconic.identity: Big, slow-swelling brass chords opening up in a huge space.

iconic.name: Deep pulsing drone
iconic.identity: A deep, low drone pulsing in time under everything.

iconic.name: Airy synth flute
iconic.identity: A breathy, soft flute-like lead with a gentle delayed vibrato.

iconic.name: Warm analog arpeggio, filter slowly opening
iconic.identity: A warm saw arpeggio whose filter opens slowly over bars.

iconic.name: Pulsing sequenced bass
iconic.identity: A steady pulsing bass line whose filter slowly opens.

iconic.name: Warm analog swell pad
iconic.identity: Thick, slowly swelling analog pad: dreamy but uneasy.

iconic.name: Eerie gliding lead
iconic.identity: A detuned, gliding, slightly unstable lead that howls above.

iconic.name: Glassy plinks
iconic.identity: Small glassy bell notes, nostalgic and sparkling.

targets.name: Short plucky bass
targets.identity: Every note a short bop: snappy filter, quick decay.

targets.name: Staccato square bass
targets.identity: Hollow, punchy square bass, short and tight.

targets.name: Short distorted stab bass
targets.identity: A short, hard, distorted bass stab.

targets.name: Punchy sub-kick bass
targets.identity: A short, deep thump: the pitch drops into the sub.

iconic2.name: 80s analog filter pluck
iconic2.identity: A warm saw pluck with a quick, slightly resonant filter snap and a classic chorus.

iconic2.name: Trance supersaw pluck
iconic2.identity: Seven detuned saws in a bright, fast pluck with a big delay.

iconic2.name: Future bass marimba pluck
iconic2.identity: A soft FM marimba: a round wooden knock with a little shimmer.

iconic2.name: Muted guitar pluck
iconic2.identity: A palm-muted plucked string: tight, woody and short.

iconic2.name: Pizzicato pluck
iconic2.identity: A string section plucked short: two detuned saw layers with a fast filter snap.

iconic2.name: Space-echo pluck
iconic2.identity: A short pluck into a tape echo fed back so far it swirls and smears.

iconic2.name: Soft harp-like pluck
iconic2.identity: A gentle plucked string with a chorus, floating in a big room.

iconic2.name: Combo organ
iconic2.identity: A bright transistor combo organ with its own vibrato: sixties garage and psychedelia.

iconic2.name: Harmonium
iconic2.identity: Reedy pulse tones with the bellows audible, swelling slightly as they breathe.

iconic2.name: Detuned honky-tonk upright
iconic2.identity: Two detuned piano-like layers beating against each other: a saloon piano gone wrong.

iconic2.name: Piano + bell layer
iconic2.identity: An FM piano with a glassy bell an octave and more above: the eighties layered piano.

iconic2.name: Phaser Rhodes
iconic2.identity: A tine electric piano through a swirling stage phaser.

iconic2.name: Celesta
iconic2.identity: Tiny glassy keyboard bells: sweet and fragile.

iconic2.name: Warm dreamy combo organ
iconic2.identity: A soft combo organ, chorused, floating in a vast room: dream pop.

iconic2.name: Minimoog solo lead
iconic2.identity: Three fat saws (one an octave down) through a singing ladder filter, gliding.

iconic2.name: "Axel F" lead
iconic2.identity: Punchy, short square-and-saw notes with a snappy filter: a bouncing staccato hook.

iconic2.name: "Crockett's Theme" lead
iconic2.identity: An expressive, chorused lead with a deep vibrato and glides: mid-eighties TV noir.

iconic2.name: Jarre "Oxygène" lead
iconic2.identity: A thin, whistling lead swirling through a slow phaser.

iconic2.name: G-funk whistle lead
iconic2.identity: A high sine an octave up, sliding between notes with a fast vibrato.

iconic2.name: TB-303 acid lead
iconic2.identity: A saw through a screaming resonant diode filter, accented and sliding.

iconic2.name: Supersaw trance lead
iconic2.identity: A wall of seven detuned saws with an octave on top, in a big echo.

iconic2.name: "Popcorn" square lead
iconic2.identity: A bouncing, plucky square lead with a snappy filter.

iconic2.name: Theremin / sci-fi sine lead
iconic2.identity: A pure sine sliding slowly between notes with a wide, constant vibrato.

iconic2.name: Screaming distorted saw lead
iconic2.identity: Saws driven into hard clipping, cutting and nearly out of control.

iconic2.name: Talking formant lead
iconic2.identity: A lead whose vowel slowly shifts as it plays: it seems to talk.

iconic2.name: PWM soft lead
iconic2.identity: A warm, hollow pulse whose width slowly breathes.

iconic2.name: Square lead with delay
iconic2.identity: A simple square melody echoing in dotted time.

iconic2.name: FM bell lead
iconic2.identity: A glassy, bell-like FM melody voice.

iconic2.name: Laser / zap lead
iconic2.identity: A saw lead that zaps down in pitch on every note.

iconic2.name: Gliding wobbly psych lead
iconic2.identity: Detuned saws gliding slowly between notes, wobbling through a phaser.

iconic2.name: Squiggly space-rock lead
iconic2.identity: A resonant saw whose filter squiggles fast while the pitch drifts.

iconic2.name: Tape-warped lead
iconic2.identity: A lead on badly warped tape: the pitch wanders and sags.

iconic2.name: "I Feel Love" sequence
iconic2.identity: A low saw sequence with a short, snappy filter: driving sixteenths an octave apart.

iconic2.name: "Blue Monday" sequence
iconic2.identity: A cold square sequence stuttering in sixteenths.

iconic2.name: "Baba O'Riley" organ arp
iconic2.identity: A hypnotic organ pattern with a fast tremolo.

iconic2.name: "Children" pluck arp
iconic2.identity: A soft piano-like FM arp with a long echo in a huge space.

iconic2.name: Squelchy acid sequence
iconic2.identity: A heavily accented diode-filter sequence, squelching and biting.

iconic2.name: Sample-and-hold bleeps
iconic2.identity: A resonant filter jumping to a random step on every sixteenth: computer bleeps.

iconic2.name: Melodica
iconic2.identity: A breathy free reed with a wobbly, sad vibrato and air on every note.

iconic2.name: Accordion / bandoneon
iconic2.identity: Reedy layers detuned against each other (the musette beat), bellows swelling the level.

iconic2.name: Reversed keys
iconic2.identity: Every note swells in backwards with the tone opening late, then cuts off.

iconic2.name: 80s/90s digital keys
iconic2.identity: A glassy FM bell attack over a soft sustained pad body.

iconic2.name: Synth stab keys
iconic2.identity: Short, punchy detuned-saw chord stabs with a quick filter snap.

iconic2.name: Ambient sustain-pedal piano
iconic2.identity: A soft piano whose notes all ring on into each other, a long wash of release and room.

iconic2.name: Soft keys: Cotton Tines
iconic2.identity: A soft electric piano played at a whisper: round tines with no bark, warm and close.

iconic2.name: Soft keys: Hush Vibes
iconic2.identity: A soft vibraphone with a slow tremolo, hit with yarn mallets in a dim room.

iconic2.name: Soft keys: Sleep Organ
iconic2.identity: A soft sine organ, two drawbars and nothing else, breathing slowly in the dark.

iconic2.name: Soft keys: Quiet Reed
iconic2.identity: A reedy electric piano turned all the way down: soft, round, with a lazy tremolo.

iconic2.name: Soft keys: Breath Keys
iconic2.identity: Soft triangle keys with a little air in every note, like a sigh between chords.

iconic2.name: Soft pluck: Paper Pluck
iconic2.identity: A muted, papery string pluck: barely there, dry and gentle.

iconic2.name: Soft pluck: Velvet Pick
iconic2.identity: A soft triangle pluck with an octave shadow and a slow chorus, velvet-smooth.

iconic2.name: Soft pluck: Wood Hush
iconic2.identity: A soft wooden mallet on a marimba bar: a warm knock that fades fast.

iconic2.name: Soft arp: Cradle Arp
iconic2.identity: A slow, soft sine-bell arpeggio rocking back and forth like a cradle.

iconic2.name: Soft arp: Glass Lullaby
iconic2.identity: A glassy music-box arpeggio, small and sweet, ringing in a big quiet room.

iconic2.name: Soft arp: Breathing Arp
iconic2.identity: A soft arpeggio with air in every note, rising and falling like slow breathing.

iconic2.name: Soft arp: Slow Tide
iconic2.identity: A soft saw arpeggio whose filter rises and falls over the bars like a slow tide.
